body:
tracker.py:509-536: the owner-clearing branch (claimed -> open/blocked) assigns resolved_owner = None into replace(), so an in-memory Issue carries None where the field is declared `owner: str`. It works by accident because to_record() tests truthiness.

Also: the guard `issue.owner is not None` at tracker.py:499 is dead code — a loaded issue's owner is always a string ("" when absent).

Fix: normalize the cleared owner to "" and drop the dead check. Consider a dev-only mypy/pyright pass as follow-up to catch this class of drift (separate decision, possibly own ticket).
title: Normalize cleared owner to empty string in update_issue
